review:
A golden beehive on 60 lines. Scatters pay anywhere, and six or more bees trigger Hold & Win.

Inside, there are four prizes and multipliers placed on cells before the round; if a mystery symbol lands on a multiplier cell, that multiplier applies to its value at the end. Expanding wilds help in the base game. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP. A polished take on the land-based style.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
